prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a second vehicle that entered the intersection during the red phase. Initial photos of both vehicles received from the insured. Police report requested from the responding agency. Claimant has retained counsel, who has requested that all communication be directed to their office.

Entry 2: Received notice of representation from claimant's attorney. Letter of representation confirms the attorney will handle the bodily injury component. Requested the claimant's medical authorization form through counsel. Reviewed scene diagram in the police report, which shows the claimant's vehicle entering on a green signal. Liability appears to favor the claimant at this stage, pending witness statements.

Entry 3: Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder following the impact and has been seen at an urgent care facility. Records requested through counsel. Adjuster noted that the claimant's attorney stated the injury is expected to require ongoing treatment, including physical therapy. Vehicle damage appraisal completed with the repair shop, and the estimate is being reviewed against the photos on file.

Entry 4: Spoke with the attorney's paralegal regarding the status of the medical records. Records from the urgent care visit have arrived and show a diagnosis consistent with a soft tissue injury to the shoulder. Follow-up orthopedic evaluation has been scheduled per the records. Requested a recorded statement from the claimant, to be taken with counsel present. Independent witness contact still outstanding.

Entry 5: Recorded statement completed with claimant and counsel present. Claimant describes the other vehicle accelerating through the intersection as the light changed. Witness statement from a pedestrian obtained and is consistent with the claimant's account. File referred to the bodily injury unit for evaluation of the shoulder treatment and any further documentation from the orthopedic provider. Reserve review scheduled.
